description: This file defines the AzureAIVectorStoreConfig class, which provides configuration and transformation methods for integrating Azure AI Search as a vector store within a larger system. It includes methods for constructing requests, processing responses, and managing environment details specific to Azure AI Search.

classes.name: AzureAIVectorStoreConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Azure AI Search vector store, providing methods to generate requests, validate environment, and process responses specific to Azure AI Search API.

methods.name: get_vector_store_endpoints_by_type
methods.description: Returns the API endpoints for read and write operations.

methods.name: get_auth_credentials
methods.description: Generates authentication headers using provided API key.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates and constructs environment headers for Azure.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the base URL for Azure AI Search API based on service name or provided base.

methods.name: transform_search_vector_store_request
methods.description: Creates the search request URL and body, including embedding generation for the query.

methods.name: transform_search_vector_store_response
methods.description: Transforms the Azure AI Search API response into a standard search results format.

methods.name: transform_create_vector_store_request
methods.description: Not implemented; placeholder for creating vector store request.

methods.name: transform_create_vector_store_response
methods.description: Not implemented; placeholder for processing vector store creation response.
